transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, I haven't been sleeping. I'm usually very disciplined about my routine, but lately, since my cousin passed away... I just lie there. I keep replaying that night. And when I do sleep, I wake up around 3 or 4 in the morning with these... flashes of the hospital. I'm having to go into board meetings feeling like I've only slept in fragments.
Do you feel guilty about your cousin's death?
Guilty? No. I... I don't think so. There wasn't anything I could have done, so... no. I don't really see why I would feel guilty. I just... I just want to focus on fixing my sleep.
Do you find yourself repeatedly thinking about something or feeling a strong need to repeat certain actions?
No. I mean... aside from what I already told you about the hospital, no. I don't have any urge to repeat actions or anything like that. I'm really just here because of the sleep.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time since your cousin passed away?

No, not really. I mean... it is a loss, obviously, but... no. I wouldn't say I'm just sitting around feeling sad. I have a company to run, so I have to keep moving forward. Like I said, it's... it's really just the sleep that's the issue right now.
Have you lost any weight since your cousin passed away?
No. I haven't really been paying attention to a scale or anything, but... no. My clothes fit the same. I haven't noticed any changes there.
Do you find that you are enjoying things as much as you used to?

I suppose... well, things are just different right now. I don't know if it's about enjoyment, exactly. It's more like... even when I'm around family, like at the prayer gatherings we had, or when my nieces were trying to be comforting... I just did what was expected. I behaved properly. But I didn't really feel any warmth from it. No relief or anything. It's just... quiet, I guess. Like that part of me is just turned off for now.
Are there activities that you usually find pleasurable, but now you don't enjoy them as much?
Not really. I mean... I mostly just work. I haven't really been doing much else to notice if I enjoy it or not. The company keeps me busy, so... that's just where my focus is right now.
Are there things you used to look forward to that you no longer look forward to?
I don't think so. I haven't really thought about the future much lately. Just taking things one day at a time, mostly.
Do you feel like you're not getting any pleasure from the things you're doing?
I... I don't really know how else to put it. Like I said, I'm just doing what needs to be done right now. Pleasure doesn't really factor into it.
Are there things you usually do that you've stopped doing since your cousin passed away?

I... suppose I've stepped back from a few things. I'm still showing up for the essential meetings, of course. But... I've had to delegate some of my community obligations. And I guess my workdays are a little shorter right now. I'm just... not quite as steady or effective with people as I normally am. So, I'm just handling what I have to.
Are you doing fewer things that you normally enjoy because they don't interest you as much as they used to?
I haven't really noticed that. Like I said, I'm just focusing on what has to be done. I haven't really thought about whether I'm interested in things or not.
Are you finding that the things you do feel empty or without much interest to you nowadays?
I don't... I wouldn't use the word empty. I'm just getting through the day. I haven't really been paying attention to how interesting things are.
Are you less interested in the things you're doing now compared to before your cousin passed away?

I... really couldn't say. It's not something I'm keeping track of. The work is the same, and I'm just doing what's in front of me. I haven't really stopped to compare how I feel about it now versus before.
Are you having trouble functioning in your daily life or at work because of how you're feeling?

I... well, I'm still showing up for the essential meetings. But I have had to delegate some of my community obligations lately. And... I suppose my workdays are a bit shorter. I'm just not quite as steady, or... as effective with people right now as I usually am. So I'm just handling what absolutely has to be done.
Are you feeling like your current state is significantly impacting your ability to function in your role at work or in your personal relationships?

I... well, like I just mentioned, I'm still handling the essential meetings. But yes, I've had to hand off my community obligations for now, and I am cutting my days a bit short. I just don't have my usual... steadiness with people at the moment. I don't know if I'd call it a significant impact, but I'm just doing what absolutely needs to be done and stepping back from the rest.
How long have you been experiencing these sleep issues and replays of that night since your cousin passed away?
It's... it's been about three weeks. Ever since that night on the highway.
How long have you felt like you're not getting any pleasure from the things you're doing?

I suppose... it's been the same amount of time. Since the accident. I just... even during the prayer gatherings we had for him, or when my nieces were trying to be comforting... I did what was expected, I behaved properly. But... I didn't feel anything. No warmth, no relief. It's like that part of me is just... quiet right now.
For how long have you felt like things are quiet or you're not feeling anything, like during the prayer gatherings?
I... I just said that. It's been about three weeks. Since the accident.
Would you say you've noticed a decrease in how much you enjoy or find pleasure in activities since your cousin passed away?
Yes. As I just explained... I haven't really enjoyed anything since it happened. I'm just doing what needs to be done.
Do you think your current state is causing problems in your daily life or relationships?

I suppose it is. I... I'm still showing up for the essential meetings at work. But I've had to shorten my days. I just... I'm not as steady right now. Or as effective with people. I've also had to delegate my community obligations. I just can't do it all at the moment.
